Summary from our call:
- Primary use: customer-facing summarization + search ranking.
- SLO target: sub-300ms tail for single-turn queries at ~40 req/s.
- Data concerns: PII redaction and regional residency (US).
- Timeline: POC in January, production by end of Q1.

Next step (ask): schedule a focused technical deep dive with our infra engineer (Diego) and your platform lead. To keep this tight — I can lock one of two compact slots next week:
- Option A: Tue Dec 8, 09:00–09:25 PT (15–25m)
- Option B: Wed Dec 9, 11:30–11:55 PT (25m)

If neither works, please share two windows and we’ll accommodate. To reduce churn, these are intentionally short slots so we can confirm and send a concise agenda. Calendar lock: https://cal.redwood.com/lock/rdw-4721

Attached: discovery notes and a one-pager on our serving/runtime differentiators.

Thanks — I’ll wait for a quick thumbs-up and will add Diego when we confirm.

Best,
Logan Wright

logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138
